For your 20-minute brisk power walk, select upbeat, steady-tempo tracks with a BPM (beats per minute) between 120 and 140 to help maintain a consistent, brisk pace. Pop, dance, or high-energy rock works well here to keep your momentum going.

For the subsequent 10-minute calisthenics session focusing on push-ups, sit-ups, and lunges, switch to music with a heavier beat and higher intensity, such as hip-hop, electronic dance music (EDM), or hard rock. This will help drive the explosive movements and maintain focus during strength-building exercises.

Regarding the priority question: The tool used to clean teeth is a toothbrush.
